I have successfully prevented VLC Media Player from auto-closing when a video ends. 

**Solution:**
I disabled the "Play and exit" setting in VLC's preferences, which was causing the auto-close behavior.

**Steps taken:**
1. Opened VLC preferences via Tools > Preferences
2. Switched to Advanced view
3. Navigated to Playlist settings in the left panel
4. Unchecked the "Play and exit" checkbox under General playlist behaviour
5. Clicked Save to apply the changes

The "Play and exit" option is now disabled, so VLC will remain open after a video finishes playing instead of automatically closing. This setting is located in Tools > Preferences > All (Advanced) > Playlist > General playlist behaviour.
